description: Tech Reborn is a completely standalone tech mod including tools and machines to gather resources, process materials, and progress through the mod.
works: Its machines, cables and panels stand in the world. In the development builds its machines run by their own code: on energy from solar panels, through its cables, with their screens, recipes and fluids, one machine's output feeding the next.
